definitions:
EXP-2026-10-15-stock-only-score (registered in logs/experiments.jsonl before any outcome was computed).

Plain English: the live model score already contains industry heat (6 industry inputs). A stock-only model (same recipe, those 6
inputs dropped; logs/leader_sleeve/stock_only_model) lets industry enter only once. Arms: V3.2 (hot gate + live score), V3.2_SO
(hot gate + stock-only score), BSO9 (top 9 by industry heat x stock-only score, all scored industries). Then V3.2's filters, no
refill. PASS per arm vs V3.2: both eras, max drawdown not worse by > 2 points, schedule 0 and >= 4 of 5.
contents: one row per arm, schedule 0; years = average of 5 schedules
